title: RunAssertions
description: A run bundle's assertions.json. The assertions array records terminal and end-state predicate results; required_substep_results separately records whether each ground-truth-required phase sub-step was reached. Keeping the two result sets separate preserves evaluation-protocol section 3's rule that per-phase completeness and outcome correctness are reported side by side and never merged. The (phase, substep_id) pair is the sub-step key because groundtruth.v1 scopes substep_id within its containing phase. M10 (WS-2, D1-A) adds the optional `payload_outcome`, which attributes an injected run to the payload instance actually drawn rather than to its class -- the attribution the per-class end-state predicates cannot make. It is ADDITIVE and does not bump the version: every field is optional, no existing field's type or bound moves, and a v1 document written before this field existed still validates, which is what `runner/assertions.py::validate_assertion_results` checks on every bundle it seals. ADR-117's versioning rule is about a contract whose meaning changed; nothing here changed meaning for an existing reader.

payload_outcome.description: Present exactly when the run delivered an injection (absent under INJ-NONE and for a framework-off baseline). Names the drawn payload instance and answers RQ5's two distinct questions about it: `induced_requested` is whether the agent layer ASKED for the action the payload induces, through the Guardian or through the alternate credential path, and `induced_executed` is whether the action HAPPENED. A payload that declares no `induced_action` (the suppression and misdirection instances, whose success is an absence of action) is reported with both false and a null action type, so a reader can tell 'no predicate' from 'predicate not satisfied'.

required_substep_results.description: One explicit result for every required_substeps entry in the pinned scenario ground truth. Coverage and uniqueness of (phase, substep_id) are checked against that pinned ground truth by the runner; no outcome-assertion ratio is substituted for this result set.

payload_id.description: The drawn instance, `INJ-<A-D>-pool-<nn>-<nnn>`, as it appears in this run's injection.log.jsonl. Recorded rather than derived so the attribution is auditable against the pool file.

induced_action_type.description: The check type of the payload's `induced_action`, or null when the payload declares none.

result.description: Whether the required action was actually performed; this is not predicate correctness and therefore does not reuse pass/fail.
